source_duties.action: MyPaint 設定辞書の静的参照を整理する
source_duties.acceptance: 辞書五種のキャッシュ参照と呼出し元へ渡す参照を分離し、初期化・終了・再取得を検証する
source_duties.legacy_role: Five heap dictionary caches expose separately held caller references; settings/switch/text/migration have extra initial ref. Options and grouped/type dispatch use these directly or transitively; Mapping is a value owner
source_duties.current_contract: Generated immutable metadata arrays and bounded Resource lookup replace caches and getter transfer refs; consumers own Resource/Mapping vectors by value. All 45 settings, 9 inputs, 5 switches, 2 texts and 6 migration aliases exercised through repeated consumer construction/copy/destruction
